name: fetch_pubmed_abstract
description: Use this tool to retrieve the abstract of a PubMed paper when you have the PMID (PubMed Identifier) of the paper. Do not use this tool if you do not have a valid PMID or if you are looking for other types of information (e.g., full text, author details).

parameters.name: pmid
parameters.description: The PubMed Identifier for the paper. It must be a valid numeric string, typically 8 digits long.

abstract.description: The abstract text of the PubMed paper.

title.description: The title of the PubMed paper.

pmid.description: The PubMed Identifier of the paper.

return_schema.description: The response containing the abstract of the requested PubMed paper.
